Messages.Author: prestonp
Messages.Body:
Roderick Phillips March has text which reads

Sabbat: While Roderick is ready, your minions get an additional +1 stealth on equip actions. Cold iron vulnerability.

So if he performs Magic of the Smith does he get +1 stealth ?

Messages.Author: ReverendRevolver
Messages.Body:
Magic of the Smith

+1 stealth action. Search your library for an equipment card and equip this acting vampire with it (requirements and cost apply as normal). Shuffle afterward. As above, but this is a +3 stealth action.

1 blood, etc.....

So, im not sure if it counts. It isxan equip action if you sucessfully equip (nra pac will untap you at EoT, etc.)

But im unsure otherwise. Is jack of both sides an equip action if you suceed unblocked and produce a retainer?

Messages.Author: jamesatzephyr
Messages.Body:
> prestonp wrote:
> So if he performs Magic of the Smith does he get +1 stealth ?
>
Yes, Magic of the Smith is an equip action.

[LSJ 20100125]
>
> LSJ wrote:
> > 1) If NRA PAC is in play, and vampire equips using :
> > a)Magic Of The Smith
> > b)Alastor
> > c)Concealed/Hidden Weapon
> > does he untaps at the and of the turn?
> A. Yes
> B. No. (Not an equip action)
> C. No. (Not an equip action)
>
And NRA PAC looks for equip actions.

Any minion who successfully performs an equip action untaps at the end of the turn.

Messages.Author: jamesatzephyr
Messages.Body:
> ReverendRevolver wrote:
> But im unsure otherwise. Is jack of both sides an equip action if you suceed unblocked and produce a retainer?
>
No, you'd declare what you were doing when you set the terms of the card. You don't say "I'm playing Jack of Both Sides to get some unspecified card from my hand and... now it's unblocked, it's a puppy!"

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
Just to make it clear, it is an equip action per cardtext:

> Name: Magic of the Smith
> Cardtype: Action
> Cost: 1 blood
> Discipline: Thaumaturgy
> +1 stealth action.
> [tha] Search your library for an equipment card and equip this acting vampire with it (requirements and cost apply as normal). Shuffle afterward.
> [THA] As above, but this is a +3 stealth action.

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
CSV files have always been more up-to-date than printed cards to include errata, clarification, etc. (remember the {} and =(( ))= back when LSJ was in charge?)

Anyway, I'm highly in favor of having a up-to-date text reference that can be checked when:
1/ in doubt (has the card been clarified?)
2/ not playing the latest print of the card (what does the latest version say?)

Your system doesn't work Hugh, since players won't always play with the latest print. So they'll have to check either the CSV file (through ARDB, Elder Library, or Vampidroid) or the latest print. Guess what's more convenient? And is it convenient not to have the clarified text because it differs from the printed version?

Keep in mind that I'm only talking about clarification (rewording is part of it), not errata.

Writing "+1 stealth equip action" is a clarification. Players in doubt that check the online text will get that information.
